title: REQUIREMENT-GAPS.json
description: Structured sidecar for REQUIREMENT-GAPS.md, written by the requirement-gaps skill. Consolidates every produced doc's pending_review items (+ structural quality gap-reports) for one feature into one tracked backlog with stable, append-only ids.

id.description: Stable, append-only per stage: <stage>-<n>. Never renumbered or reused.

impact.description: Stage/doc affected if corrected — used by Apply to map to a Mode B change-list entry

raised_in.description: Every doc that raised this same question (post-dedupe)

dispatched_stages.description: Stages re-dispatched via Mode B when this row was applied

status_note.description: e.g. "not yet reflected — needs another pass" when still open after apply
